entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Scottish physician, missionary, and explorer (1813–1873) who became the first European to cross the width of southern Africa and to see Victoria Falls. His explorations of the Zambezi River and search for the source of the Nile opened up the African interior to European knowledge. His anti-slavery advocacy and famous meeting with Stanley ("Dr. Livingstone, I presume?") made him a Victorian icon.
